mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of all periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.8% signals labor market deterioration, which weakens consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rises >0.2pp in 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 2 months indicates a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in the past 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline >0.5% in the past 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production growth regimes (INDPRO annualized growth > 2%), a decline in INDPRO over the past month signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.3% in the past month
failure_condition: In high industrial production growth regimes (INDPRO annualized growth > 2%), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines >0.3% in the past month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annualized signals potential monetary tightening, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL rises >0.2pp in 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of all periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%), a slowdown in GDP growth (below 1.5% annualized) signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annualized growth rate declines below 1.5%
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 annualized growth declines below 1.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a monetary tightening cycle, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.1pp in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises >0.1pp and CPIAUCSL rises >0.1pp in the past month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
